messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: alert 'log_high_error_rate:ingest-errors' fired in us-west-2 — 120 errors/min over 5m. Page: @sara (oncall). https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/1790001234

sara (oncall): acked. looking now.

sara (oncall): quick glance at the logs + grafana: spike at ~14:07, aligns with a batch-deploy. lots of 'connection reset by peer' and a handful of 502s. a big chunk looks like internal healthchecks (10.0.0.0/24) though.

mike (eng-sre): if healthchecks are inflating the counts we should add an exclusion to the log alert rule. current rule is roughly:

```
rule: logs("service:ingest AND level:error")
| parse message as remote_addr, message
| count() by bin(1m)
| where count > 100
```

mike (eng-sre): suggestion to temp-filter: `not match(remote_addr, "^10\\.")` and `not match(message, "healthcheck")`. also consider bumping threshold while we investigate.

sara (oncall): doing that now — I'll add the exclusion and raise threshold to 150 for 15m, then we observe. will also mute pages to oncall-next for 15m while we stabilize.

incident-bot: Mute applied by sara for 15m on channel eng-oncall:alert:1790001234 (reason: triage/false-positive suspected)

aj (oncall-next): noted. i'll take handoff after 15. please leave a note about dashboard changes so i can follow up.

sara (oncall): temporary rule patch (applied):

```
rule: logs("service:ingest AND level:error")
| where not match(remote_addr, "^10\\.")
| where not match(message, "(?i)healthcheck|hc-")
| count() by bin(1m)
| where count > 150
```

sara (oncall): posted the change via infra-api and added a note in the incident thread. monitoring closely for ~10m.

paul (platform): can you add the exclusion to the permanent rule and add a signature for the healthcheck messages? we should also create a synthetic to catch deploy-related spikes.

jess (alerts-owner): agreed — I'll own the follow-up. plan: 1) add regex signature `^healthcheck` and a header match for `X-Health` 2) create dashboard panel that breaks down errors by remote_addr and by deploy_id 3) add a regression alert for deploy windows (2x baseline within 10m).

paul (platform): opening RDW-1234 (ops: alert tuning + signature) and linking this thread. cc: @jess.

sara (oncall): command used to update rule (internal):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://infra-api.internal/alerts/1790001234/update \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"threshold":150,"filters":["not match(remote_addr,\"^10\\\\.\")","not match(message,\"(?i)healthcheck|hc-\")"]}'
```

mike (eng-sre): observed counts drop to ~40 after 6m. looks stable. no customer-facing errors reported in Sentry or support. :thumbsup:

aj (oncall-next): taking over monitoring. i'll add a dashboard panel for the new query and open a PR to add the regex signature to the permanent rule. i'll also add a short runbook blurb: when ingest spikes correlate with deploys, mute for 30m, trace to deploy id, then revert if customer-impacting.

jess (alerts-owner): small note — instead of broad IP filter, prefer adding a 'source_type=healthcheck' tag at ingestion if possible. longer term we should annotate logs so filters are reliable.

sara (oncall): fair. short term this buys us headroom. i'll leave the thread and handoff to @aj.

incident-bot: alert cleared at 1790001305 — last 1m count: 48. alert status: RESOLVED.

aj (oncall-next): closing handoff. will follow up with RDW-1234 and the dashboard PR. leaving the page unmuted. :eyes:

paul (platform): thanks everyone — i'll own the permanent rule update + runbook updates. linking RDW-1234: https://go/rdw/ops/RDW-1234

sara (oncall): thanks — closing this thread for now. jotting final notes in RDW-1234.

mike (eng-sre): quick follow-up suggestion: create a small alert signature for `timeout|connection reset by peer` so we can route to network team quickly next time. will add to RDW-1234 as well.

jess (alerts-owner): noted. adding to ticket checklist.

(reacts: sara -> :white_check_mark:, aj -> :thumbsup:, mike -> :eyes:)
